# MediaPipe browser assets

The virtual-background feature includes these unmodified Google MediaPipe assets:

- `tasks-vision/`: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` version 1.0.1, Apache-2.0 license.
- `models/selfie_segmenter_landscape.tflite`: MediaPipe Selfie Segmenter landscape model.

Project and license information: <https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe>
